newsitem.title: JAPAN: KDD says NTT may join cable project.
newsitem.headline: KDD says NTT may join cable project.

text.p: Kokusai Denshin Denwa Co Ltd (KDD) said on Tuesday that it and AT&T Corp were considering including Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp (NTT) in an undersea optic-fibre cable project.
The network would link the United States, Japan and China by 2000.
"NTT's participation in the project is among many things currently being considered," said a spokesman for KDD, Japan's largest international telecoms carrier.
The Japanese business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said on Tuesday that NTT, Japan's largest telephone company, would join AT&T and KDD in the 100 billion yen project.
The paper said that part ownership of the network would put NTT on an equal footing with KDD when NTT gets approval, expected as early as 1999, to offer international telecommunication services.
A spokesman for NTT said on Tuesday morning that the company had no immediate official comment on the report.
